function.name: calculate_velocity
function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s. This is a float type value.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time for which the object is in motion in seconds. This is a float type value.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to current movie release schedules. If you let me know a bit more—such as a particular genre, region, or whether you’re looking for new releases on streaming platforms—I can suggest some recent titles that fit your interests.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What are the latest movie releases?" We have no direct tool to fetch latest movie releases. There's no tool for that. We can respond with a general answer or ask clarifying question. We can also mention we don't have real-time data. So we should respond politely, maybe ask if they want specific genre or region.
